mechanism: v95 数学 smoke test: 验证 exp_0^c(v) parameterization 让 curvature 真改变 pairwise rank (修复 v94 数学失败根因). 对比 v94 (e = ρ/√c · u/|u|) 让 c 退化为统一缩放.

user_diagnosis_verification.v94_design_math_failure: e = ρ/√c · u/|u| → √c|e| = ρ, 代入 Poincaré distance arccosh((1-c|x|²)(1-c|y|²) ...) 后 c 几乎全部消掉, 只剩 1/√c 统一缩放. rank 不变. v94 smoke test E/E2 Spearman=1.0000 验证用户分析正确.
user_diagnosis_verification.v95_design_math_fix: e = exp_0^c(v) = (tanh(√c|v|)/(√c|v|)) · v, ρ = tanh(√c|v|). curvature 真参与非线性映射, 不同 |v| 的 codeword 发生不同程度 radial deformation, d_c rank 真改变.

A_v_norm_~1.7_(N(0,0.09I)).interpretation: 大 norm v → ρ 接近 tanh saturation, c 变化让 saturation rate 不同, Spearman 显著下降 0.946 < 0.97 ✓

B_v_norm_~4.5_(N(0,0.64I)).interpretation: 更大 norm → 完全饱和, 但仍有 Spearman drop 0.955 ✓

C_v_norm_uniform_[0.2,0.7].interpretation: 中等 norm, ρ 远离 saturation, c 影响缩放主导, Spearman drop 较小 0.996

D_v_norm_uniform_[0.05,0.5].interpretation: 小 norm, ρ 远离 saturation, c 影响小, Spearman drop 极小 0.999

E_fixed_rho_0.45_uniform_u.interpretation: 完全 rank 一致 — 数学上证明 v94 design 让 c 退化为统一缩放

E2_rho_uniform_[0.2,0.7].interpretation: 即使 ρ 不固定, v94 parameterization 仍让 c 退化为统一缩放

design_verdict.interpretation: exp_0^c(v) parameterization 真让 curvature 改变 pairwise rank (Spearman 0.946-0.999 vs c=0.1 reference). v94 baseline 完全 rank 一致 (1.0000). 验证用户分析正确: v94 parameterization 在数学上把 c 抵消成不可辨识 scale parameter.

smoke_test_scenario_design_implication_f.implication: v95 训练时, codeword 的 |v| 必须足够大才能让 curvature 真生效. 建议 tangent norm 约束 [0.5, 2.0] 或更大, 让 v 训练到 tanh saturation 区间附近.
smoke_test_scenario_design_implication_f.training_design_recommendation: v95 = v87 baseline + exp_0^c(v_k) parameterization + per-layer learnable c_ℓ + tangent norm regularization (target ~1.0, 即 ρ 接近 0.5-0.8). 不加 D loss, 不加 A loss. Stage-1 50k smoke.
